```html
<div class="bg-white shadow-md rounded-lg overflow-hidden mt-5 p-6">
    <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
        <h2 class="text-xl font-bold mb-4">Note Show</h2>
        <button wire:click="deleteNote" class="text-red-500 hover:text-red-700 ml-4 cursor-pointer">
            Delete
        </button>
    </div>

    <div class="mt-4">
        <p wire:model="note.content">{{ $note->content }}</p>
    </div>

    @if ($note->tags)
        <div class="my-4">
            <h3 class="text-xl font-bold mb-2">Tags:</h3>
            <ul class="list-disc list-inside">
                @foreach ($note->tags as $tag)
                    <li>{{ $tag }}</li>
                @endforeach
            </ul>
        </div>
    @endif

    <button wire:click="updateNote" class="bg-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-bold py-2 px-4 rounded-lg mt-4">
        Update Note
    </button>

    <button wire:click="createTag($tag)" class="text-green-500 hover:text-green-700 ml-4 cursor-pointer">
        Create Tag
    </button>
</div>
```
